objective: Prospectively test the unfitted layered hydrogen-tank energy balance against an independent Type-III filling experiment.

source.source_description: Physical Type-III hydrogen filling experiment transcribed in the public HydDown reproducibility archive.
source.rights_boundary: The Zenodo record exposes the reproducibility archive but did not display a reusable license in the checked metadata. Retain hashes and derived metrics; do not republish the embedded measurement arrays.

frozen_model.control_volume: uniform hydrogen gas with separate aluminium liner and composite shell thermal states
frozen_model.internal_volume_m3: pi * diameter^2 * length / 4 from source geometry
frozen_model.liner_and_shell_mass: wall area * layer thickness * layer density
frozen_model.inlet_mass_flow: piecewise-linear interpolation of the source mdot boundary, clamped to its first and last values
frozen_model.gas_to_liner_heat_transfer: Churchill-Chu horizontal-cylinder natural-convection correlation evaluated from instantaneous hydrogen properties
frozen_model.liner_to_shell_conductance: wall area divided by half-layer conduction resistances in series
frozen_model.shell_to_ambient_heat_transfer: source h_outer multiplied by wall area
frozen_model.integration: BDF with rtol 1e-7 and atol 1e-9; output at the union of measured pressure and gas-temperature times

primary_screens.joint_rule: all four primary screens must pass

claim_boundary: A pass supports only transfer of the layered vehicle-tank filling submodel to one independent Type-III experiment. It does not validate station cascade control, compressor or precooler dynamics, dispenser metering, Type-IV geometry, consequence distance, safety logic, or SAGA effectiveness.
